svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two lengths of 300 from 50.8 x 3.2 fibreglass tube; seal the ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sand the bore with coarse paper on a dowel until the pole tube slides in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (about 0.2 clearance each side); try it often, do not overdo it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill one 10.5 hole across the sleeve, 75 from the middle (225 from one end)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond the other half (150) onto the top of the lower section with epoxy,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hole end sticking up; wipe off squeeze-out; cure a full day

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Then slide the upper section in, drill through its pin hole into line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: upper section slides in and out by hand; the pin goes through both
